name: agent-keep-awake
description: Click the ready coffee cup to request system and screen protection for long runs. Click again to stop. Timed or until-off sessions; no automatic chat monitoring.
author: apkola29

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Keep awake and Off use a fixed local power request, so they work in Restricted Mode. Auto - Copilot activity is unavailable in this build and would also require a trusted local workspace.

commands.title: Choose Mode (Off, Keep Awake or Auto)
Choose Duration for a Timed Session
Stop Timed Session (Same as Turn Off)

agentKeepAwake.durationHours.markdownDescription: Duration in hours when you click the coffee cup or use **Agent Awake: Toggle Awake**. **0** (default) means until you turn it off or close/reload this VS Code window. Use **0.5** for 30 minutes, or **1, 2, 4, 8** and other values up to 24 hours. Changes apply to the next session only, never alter an active hold, and never turn Agent Awake on automatically. The explicit Keep Awake Until Turned Off command ignores this setting.

agentKeepAwake.showStatusBarItem.markdownDescription: Show the ready coffee cup in the status bar. Click once to request protection; click again to stop. Green means the native helper acknowledged the request, not immunity from forced sleep or policy. Hiding the control never releases an active hold; use **Agent Awake: Turn Off (Allow Sleep)** from the Command Palette.

scripts.test:all: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run test:os && npm run test:integration
